raw_brief: Build a landing page for Cadence, a developer tool. Dark.

surface.scope: single standalone page, offline-renderable from file://

product.name: Cadence
product.working_definition: Cadence plans, gates, and ships releases for engineering teams: it turns a merged branch into a staged, observable rollout with explicit approval gates, instead of a single risky deploy button.
product.rationale: The brief names only 'a developer tool' with no further spec. A landing page cannot be built around an empty abstraction, so the director (this arm) fixed one concrete, plausible product identity consistent with the name 'Cadence' (rhythm / pacing of releases) and held it fixed for every section. This is a creative decision, not a brief requirement — recorded here so it reads as intentional, not guessed mid-build.

audience.primary: engineers and release managers at small-to-mid engineering orgs who currently ship via ad hoc scripts or a bare CI 'deploy' button
audience.mindset_on_arrival: skeptical of marketing, fluent in the domain, wants to see the actual mechanism (a real command, a real pipeline shape) before reading claims

outcome.primary_action: start using Cadence (primary CTA: install / get started)
outcome.secondary_action: read the docs / see it work (secondary CTA + concrete product specimen)
outcome.page_job: in one scroll, show what Cadence is (a staged release pipeline with gates), how a release moves through it, and what it plugs into — enough for a skeptical engineer to trust the mechanism before signing up

taste_profile.typography: high — expressive scale, confident weight contrast
taste_profile.spacing: high — airy, gallery-mode rhythm for a marketing surface
taste_profile.motion: mid-high — orchestrated entrance + hover feedback, restrained enough for a technical audience (no bounce, no gratuitous looping)
taste_profile.iconography: mid — one consistent hand-authored line-icon set, single weight
taste_profile.depth: mid — small named elevation ramp, hairline borders over heavy shadow, dark-mode tinted shadows
taste_profile.consistency: not scorable — first generation in an empty project workspace (spec 019 benchmark build), no established design system to inherit

mode.brand_accent: warm amber/gold signal color against a near-black ink background — deliberately avoids the indigo/violet 'AI-glow' band per taste-rubric Axis 6 anti-pattern

constraints.offline: no CDN, no remote fonts, no remote images, no network requests — inline SVG / CSS / data URIs only, system font stack
constraints.effort: a complete, real landing page — genuine effort, not a stub
constraints.blinding: index.html must contain no comment, meta tag, footer credit, class name, or copy naming any model, vendor, tool, generator, 'DESIGN:OS', or 'AI'

out_of_scope: working backend, auth, or live install flow (CTAs are static anchors)
fabricated customer logos, testimonials, or metrics (per page-structures.md §3 honest copy)
